ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with localized high-intensity (white) mottled regions; macro-level ratio estimated at 5:1 dark to light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottling concentrated on the upper-inner quadrant of the left lobe and the central-outer region of the right lobe. Distinctive high-intensity circular focal spot on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with deep bounding-box penetration relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with varying pixel-amplitudes; highest frequency of peaks observed on the medial sections of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve terminating in tapered, encrusted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible, dense clusters of circular, high-contrast yellowish-white pixels located at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle growth.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear marks (scratches) visible on the left lobe, particularly near the lower margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle clusters on distal tips and multiple white linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast circular white spot located in the central-lateral region of the left lobe.
